text_block_list.text:
As a reward for winning so many races,
we came to the hot spring trip won in the lottery.
When I went to check on Taiki Shuttle's room—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay--!!
It's the scent of tataaami--!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is genuine traditional Japanese style!
Truly Fooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan!!
My room is super amazinggg!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Look, please!
In this wooden box, there are sweets and a teapot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Waaao! I can see a blue river from the window!!
Could that smoke be an open-air bath?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Because, because I've been looking forward to this ever since I won it in the lottery!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was looking at the website the whooole time yesterday too, and I couldn't stop being excited, yes!~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Kaiseki cuisine, tatami room,
free-flowing hot spring source...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All of it looks so much fuuun, YESSS!!!
I'm so haaaappyyyy!!!

After waiting a while for the excitement to die down,
the two of us headed to the hot springs.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whewwwwww!
That was such a nice bath~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It was so white-y,
and full of hot spring health be-ne-fits, wasn't it~~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It got way too toasty warm!
Phew, it's hot!
choice_data_list: Shall we go for a walk until mealtime?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Enjoying the cool evening air?
That sounds wonderful, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A stroll after a hot spring is also so aesthetically pleasing~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's it, that's it!
It is so *miyabi*, yes~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Ever since I came here, it's been so much fun, and my heart's been feeling so warm the whole time...♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah! I finally figured it out! The reason why you didn't go on the trip right away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whether after losing, or before a race,
I've never felt this exci-ted!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is a reward for working hard, yes?!
I'm so glad I gave it my all and won, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san was the one who made this
the most wonderful hot springs trip ever, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...You always find ways to make me happy
like this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Training so hard for me
so that I could win lots of races...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Like being there for me when I'm lonely.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Of course, is it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much
for coming all this way with me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because you stayed by my side, Trainer...
I was able to keep looking forward properly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's about time I graduated
from being the only one feeling so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's make it a reward for both of us!
Let's work hard together and go on another trip!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Because we—
choice_data_list: We're in this together, after all.
We're in this together, after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, let's go eat fooood!!
I'm so hungry I could staaaarve!!

Afterward, we savored the vibrant dishes
and fully enjoyed the rest of our trip.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Taiki Shuttle...
